test_pickle_expression: test pickling a polars expression like pl.col('foo').sum() and verifying the deserialized expression matches the original
test_pickle_series_datetime: test pickling a polars Series with Datetime('ns') dtype and verifying the deserialized Series preserves the time unit
test_pickle_dataframe: test pickling a polars DataFrame and verifying the deserialized DataFrame equals the original using assert_frame_equal
test_pickle_lazyframe_udf: test pickling a LazyFrame with a UDF via map_batches and verifying the deserialized LazyFrame produces correct results
test_serialize_lazyframe: test serializing a LazyFrame with serialize() and deserializing with LazyFrame.deserialize() to round-trip the query plan
